name: Smart Sales Assistant
summary: A multi-business WhatsApp sales assistant with product browsing, an order state machine, human escalation, and a React dashboard for conversations and catalogues.
problem: Small businesses answer the same WhatsApp questions all day: price, availability, delivery, and how to order. A generic chatbot makes that worse when it invents an answer or cannot hand a real customer to a person.
solution: A Flask service receives WhatsApp Cloud API webhooks and routes each message by intent: information, order, or escalation. Information replies are grounded in the business catalogue and customer context. Orders move through an explicit state machine. Complaints and requests for a person go to a human. A React dashboard handles businesses, products, customers, conversations, and stats, with JWT authentication and per-business credentials.
